title: Disobliging

inlines.v: DISOBLIGING, participle present tense 1. Offending; contravening the wishes of; injuring slightly. 2. adjective Not obliging; not disposed to gratify the wishes of another; not disposed to please; unkind; offensive; unpleasing; unaccommodating; as a disobliging coachman.
